content.value_statement: Multi-state employers must organize federal policies alongside different state requirements. This guide helps AI assistants draft a shared handbook core and state supplements for legal review.
actual_capabilities: Guides a shared federal handbook core with separate state supplements.
Supports drafting EEO, ADA, PUMP Act, and FMLA policy modules using supplied workforce details.
Frames reviews of conduct, social media, and confidentiality policies around NLRA Section 7 and the referenced Stericycle standard.
Highlights state topics including paid sick leave, pay transparency, marijuana protections, and final paycheck timing.
Guides drafting acknowledgment forms and annual January review schedules.
limitations: Includes only a Markdown guide; original scripts, extension source, and templates are not included.
Does not supply specific leave accrual rates or city-level ordinance details.
Does not demonstrate live legal research, automatic law updates, or guaranteed compliance.
Requires jurisdiction-specific attorney review; total headcount alone does not establish every employee's FMLA eligibility.

use_cases.title: Prepare a First Multi-State Handbook
use_cases.description: Draft a shared handbook outline and state supplement plan before hiring employees outside the company's home state.

use_cases.title: Review Workplace Conduct Policies
use_cases.description: Identify conduct, confidentiality, and social media language that needs review for protected concerted activity concerns.

use_cases.title: Organize Counsel Review
use_cases.description: Prepare policy drafts, unresolved legal questions, acknowledgment language, and an annual review schedule for a multi-state client.

prompt_templates.title: Outline a Handbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Outline a US employee handbook for [company] operating in [states]. Separate shared core policies from state supplements and list missing workforce details.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Federal Policy Modules
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft EEO, ADA, PUMP Act, and FMLA policy sections using [headcount and worksite details]. Flag uncertain applicability and questions for counsel.

prompt_templates.title: Review Conduct Language
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [policy text] for potential NLRA Section 7 concerns using the guide's Stericycle framework. Suggest narrower wording and flag current-law verification needs.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-State Review Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [states, headcounts, worksite distribution, and existing policies], draft a handbook core, state supplement outlines, acknowledgment, and January review schedule. List unresolved legal questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate handbook drafting and legal review.

output_examples.input: Outline a handbook for 60 employees across Texas, California, and New York.
output: Core draft: workplace expectations, EEO, accommodation procedures, lactation policy, leave policy framework, and acknowledgment.
State supplement topics: paid sick leave, pay transparency, final pay, and other jurisdiction-specific requirements for counsel to verify.
Open question: confirm worksite distribution and individual eligibility before finalizing FMLA provisions.

output_examples.input: Review this rule: Employees may never discuss their pay with coworkers.
output: Review concern: a blanket pay-discussion ban may restrict protected concerted activity for covered employees.
Suggested draft: this policy does not prohibit lawful discussions about wages, hours, or working conditions.
Counsel review: confirm coverage, current governing standards, and consistency with related confidentiality provisions.

best_practices: Provide accurate employee counts, worksite locations, and relevant policy text before drafting.
Ask for explicit assumptions and unresolved questions rather than definitive compliance conclusions.
Verify current federal, state, and local requirements with employment counsel before distribution and during scheduled reviews.
anti_patterns: Publishing generated policies without review by employment counsel in the relevant jurisdictions.
Assuming one employee count establishes all statutory coverage and individual eligibility requirements.
Treating the guide's dated compliance claims as proof of current law or automatic updates.

faq.question: Does this skill replace employment counsel?
faq.answer: No. It supports drafting and issue identification. A licensed employment attorney should review each relevant jurisdiction before distribution.

faq.question: What files are included?
faq.answer: The reviewed package contains SKILL.md only. Original scripts, extension source, and templates are not included.

faq.question: How does it organize policies across states?
faq.answer: It recommends a shared federal core with separate state supplements for requirements that vary by jurisdiction.

faq.question: Does it provide leave accrual rates and local rules?
faq.answer: No. The guide excludes specific accrual rates and city-level ordinance details. Obtain current requirements through jurisdiction-specific research and legal review.

faq.question: Can it confirm FMLA eligibility from total headcount?
faq.answer: No. Employer coverage and individual eligibility require additional facts, including worksite distribution and applicable eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Does it automatically track changes in employment law?
faq.answer: No automatic update mechanism is included. The guide proposes annual January reviews, but users must verify current legal requirements.
